# The sandbox list the daemon writes for the hook in system_server
# (bbd/src/sandbox/identity.rs and parseSandboxList in SandboxRules.kt),
# read by the tests of both. A case is the whole file. The format of the
# cases is in README.md.
#
# line    the daemon writes the file for the meaning; the hook reads the
#         meaning from it
# read    the hook reads the meaning; the daemon does not write the file
#         in this form
# bad     the hook finds no sandboxed app in the file
#
# The meaning has one word per sandboxed uid:
# app=<uid>/<android id>[/device_ids][/installed_apps], naming the hook's
# items that are on for it.

line	10100 00000000000000aa\n	app=10100/00000000000000aa/device_ids/installed_apps
line	10100 00000000000000aa\nitems 10100 device_ids\n	app=10100/00000000000000aa/device_ids
line	10100 00000000000000aa\nitems 10100 installed_apps\n	app=10100/00000000000000aa/installed_apps
line	10100 00000000000000bb\n1010100 00000000000000aa\n	app=10100/00000000000000bb/device_ids/installed_apps	app=1010100/00000000000000aa/device_ids/installed_apps
line	10205 0123456789abcdef\nitems 10205 installed_apps\n10206 fedcba9876543210\n10207 0123456789abcdef\nitems 10207 device_ids\n	app=10205/0123456789abcdef/installed_apps	app=10206/fedcba9876543210/device_ids/installed_apps	app=10207/0123456789abcdef/device_ids
# Nothing sandboxed: the daemon removes the file, and an empty one says the same.
line

read	\t10211\t0123456789ABCDEF  \n	app=10211/0123456789abcdef/device_ids/installed_apps
read	10206 fedcba9876543210\nitems 10206 device_ids,installed_apps\n	app=10206/fedcba9876543210/device_ids/installed_apps
read	items 10207 device_ids\n10207 0123456789abcdef	app=10207/0123456789abcdef/device_ids
# The last line of a uid wins.
read	10205 0123456789abcdef\n10205 fedcba9876543210	app=10205/fedcba9876543210/device_ids/installed_apps
# Lines that do not have the shape are skipped, not the whole list.
read	\n   \n10205 0123456789abcdef\n10206\nitems 10208 device_ids\nitems abc device_ids\n10209 0123456789abcde	app=10205/0123456789abcdef/device_ids/installed_apps

bad	10206
bad	10207 0123456789abcdef extra
bad	abc 0123456789abcdef
bad	-10208 0123456789abcdef
bad	10209 0123456789abcde
bad	10210 0123456789abcdeg
bad	items 10208 device_ids
# Uids of system components, which the daemon never sandboxes.
bad	1000 0123456789abcdef
bad	101000 0123456789abcdef
bad	0 0123456789abcdef
